title: Product — Inovexa ERP | Modules and sectors
description: Inovexa ERP: sales, purchasing, stock, Tunisia-compliant invoicing, point of sale, accounting, payroll and logistics, 100% online. Modules switched on for your sector, 3-day free trial.

title: Your whole business, managed in one place

c: Inovexa ERP brings together sales, purchasing, stock, invoicing, point of sale, accounting, payroll, logistics, appointments and projects. You pick your sector when you sign up: the right modules are switched on for you, and everything runs in your browser, with nothing to install.

title: Every module, already connected
lead: A sale takes goods out of stock, feeds the accounts and updates your dashboards: you never type anything twice.

title: Built for Tunisian rules
VAT, stamp duty and withholding tax

c: VAT by rate (0, 7, 13 and 19%), stamp duty and withholding tax calculated on every document. Rates and thresholds are set in the company settings.
The ERP produces the TEIF 1.8.8 file expected by El Fatoora. Signing and sending are then done on the TTN platform, with your certificate.
Employee and employer CNSS, IRPP income-tax brackets, social solidarity contribution, family deductions and PDF payslips. Have the rates checked by your accountant.
Every amount is calculated to three decimal places, and your documents show the amount in words.

lead: Tunisian tax and payroll rules are built in from the start, and remain configurable.

title: From quote to cash

c: Quotes, purchase orders, delivery notes, invoices and credit notes follow on from each other with no retyping. Once validated, a document gets its number and can no longer be changed.
Partial payments, instalment schedules, aged receivables and payables, account statements and reminders by level.
Logged movements, several warehouses, weighted average cost, batches with expiry dates and alert thresholds.
Till sessions with an opening float, numbered receipts and a Z report at closing. Every receipt updates the stock.
Entries generated automatically (sales, purchases, payments, payroll, till), journal, general ledger, trial balance, income statement, VAT return and bank reconciliation.
Shipments, carriers and delivery tracking. Production orders with a bill of materials: the finished product enters stock, the components leave it.

lead: What the ERP actually does, module by module.

title: A workspace that fits your sector
lead: When you sign up, you choose your sector: its modules are switched on and sample products and services are suggested. You can adjust afterwards.

title: Intelligence and steering

c: Ask questions about your sales, your stock or your customers, from any page of the ERP.
A six-month projection from your history, with three scenarios: cautious, normal and optimistic.
Low stock, overdue invoices, expiring quotes, products close to their expiry date: you are warned inside the ERP.
Targets tracked continuously, revenue and margins by product and by customer, Excel and PDF exports.

lead: Practical help, based on your own data.

c: Each company only sees its own data.
You invite your colleagues and set what each of them can see and do.
A one-time code is added to your password.
Sensitive operations are logged: who did what, and when.

title: Good to know

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. Everything happens in your browser, on a computer, tablet or phone.
No. Inovexa ERP is 100% online: you need an Internet connection, including for the point of sale.
The interface is available in French, English and Spanish. PDF documents are generated in Latin characters.
One account is one company. Your colleagues work on that company’s data, each with their own access rights.

items.q: Does the ERP replace my accountant?
items.a: No. The ERP keeps your journals and prepares your statements; the chart of accounts and payroll settings should be validated with your accountant.
